//: Configuration for the static deployment of this directory (Vercel Project -> Root Directory: public). Everything the game needs is a file here: the page, its JS, /models, /sounds, /vendor/pyodide (the in-page Python engine) and /engine + /shared (that engine's code and data). There is no serverless function and no external backend -- the three /api/* endpoints the menu asks for are answered by the shim JSON in api/, the match itself runs in the browser (js/local.js), and multiplayer is hosted by the player who creates the room: tabs of one browser meet over a BroadcastChannel and other computers connect straight to that host over a WebRTC data channel (js/relay.js, js/p2p.js), the two handshake codes being passed along by hand. Nothing here talks to a broker or any other outside service.

headers.//: The /api/* answers are files here and change with every upload: never let a browser keep an old one.
Pyodide is fetched as a module (needs a JS MIME type) and as a 9 MB wasm binary: it must be cacheable, or every visit downloads it again.
The engine's own code and data change when the game does: revalidate instead of caching hard.
The page and its own code change when the game does: revalidate on every visit instead of caching hard, so a new upload is never served from a stale cache.
